s1.desc: a dim bedroom with a mustard headboard, a duck-shaped bedpost and a peach lamp

spans.view: with her head on a pillow under a pale blanket

beats.text: Polly lies on her side under the blanket and opens her eyes
Polly lifts her head and looks up to the left with rosy cheeks, her beak moving as she speaks

spans.notes: camera locked (bedpost/lamp ROI: scale 1.0002, 0.2 px). Whole skit is drawn dim (night); no colour wash, the dimness is the lighting of the set.

spans.view: with his head on a pillow under a pale blanket

beats.text: Pax rocks upright on the pillow with one fin raised, squeezing his eyes shut for a moment
Pax looks up to the right with wide shining eyes, holding his fin raised, his beak moving

spans.notes: hard cut at f28 (profile); camera locked (bedpost/lamp ROI: 0 px, scale 1.000). | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_5): Beat 28-38 says Pax nods 'with his eyes squeezed shut': his eyes are open f28-31 and f36+ and shut only at f33-35 (step-1 crops). He rocks from a tilted lie to upright with the fin raised.

spans.view: with a crumpled pale blanket pulled over the bed

beats.text: Polly gazes up from the pillow with wide eyes and rosy cheeks
Polly shuts her eyes, smiling, and nestles her head down into the pillow
Polly rolls over to turn her back, tucking herself under the blanket
Polly lies curled with her back turned, wriggling a little as she settles
Polly rolls her head back over her shoulder and stares with wide puzzled eyes

spans.notes: camera locked (compare 58/147: bedpost black; ORB 0 px from f76 on, the small early ORB wobble is her head crossing the ROI). shot_review flagged 'lead hidden under blanket': her back, head tuft and fin stay above the blanket the whole time (f84-136 seen from behind), so kept - judgement call. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_5): Beat 58-70 says Polly 'smiles with her eyes closed' from f58: her eyes are wide open with rosy cheeks f58-64 and close only from f65 (step-1 crops).; Lead visibility (the curator's judgement call): f82-136 shows only Polly's pink back and head-top above the blanket, no face. This is more than a sliver, so I keep it, but a 33-frame window [91,124) or a 21-frame window inside f84-136 is back-only.

spans.view: with a crumpled pale blanket pulled over the bed

beats.text: Pax lies curled on his side with his round back turned, shifting under the blanket
Pax pokes his feet out from under the blanket and wiggles them, still facing away

spans.notes: camera locked (compare 148/195: bedpost black; the ORB drift in the lamp ROI is Pax's back moving across it). Pax is seen only from behind (no face) for the whole span - kept as he is clearly visible; drop if back-only views are unwanted.
